dataset_name: All-India Soil Health Card Portal Data
source_organization: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (GoI)
license_status: Public Government Agronomic Portal; attribution required
intended_use: Regional soil nutrient distributions; state/district profiles; anomaly detection; range validation
Rice-specific STCR multi-output regression benchmarking (target yield 5.5 t/ha)
prohibited_use: Generalizing across all Indian soils or non-rice crops as validated prescriptions

intended_use: Optional exploratory crop suitability suggestions (22 crop classes)
prohibited_use: Calculating fertilizer doses or promising actual farm yields

source_organization: ICAR - Indian Institute of Soil Science
intended_use: Authoritative crop/district/season N-P2O5-K2O nutrient targets for Rice Wheat Sugarcane Kharif Maize Rabi Maize
prohibited_use: Applying outside matching crop district and season conditions

intended_use: Verified commercial fertilizer nutrient compositions (Urea 46% N; DAP 18% N 46% P2O5; MOP 60% K2O; SSP 16% P2O5)
prohibited_use: Treating raw grade tables as complete agronomic prescriptions

license_status: CC BY 4.0 (REST API currently paused — optional)
prohibited_use: Replacing laboratory soil reports or equating total N with available N
